text: T2 plan step 4 says the entry-row [More][Open beside] sit under the heading's LAST two slots ([+][chevron]). In list view each row ends 24 px early for the line rail (16 px line + 8 px gap = exactly one slot), so the rail occupies the chevron column. Default I am building: rows' [More][Open beside] under the heading's [view][+], chevron column above the rail; all chevrons stay in one column. resolution: Coordinator/architect decision: accept the worker's layout. Entry-row [More][Open beside] sit under the heading's [view][+]; the chevron column is shared with the line rail. The plan's 'under the last two' wording is superseded; the T2 invariant as written stands.
